title: Databricks Lakehouse Modernization Delivers 72% Faster Migration
summary: See how a Databricks lakehouse enabled healthcare data platform modernization with 72% fast migration while creating an AI-ready foundation.
body_markdown:
Together, the client and Concentrix modernized a fragmented, high-cost Hadoop environment into a governed healthcare data platform designed to reduce operational complexity, accelerate analytics, and create a scalable foundation for AI adoption.


But this was not a simple platform migration. It was a large-scale data platform modernization effort inside a highly complex healthcare environment, with strict security requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, aging source systems, and aggressive delivery timelines. Success depended not only on the target architecture, but also on building the right operating model, delivery structure, and trust from day one.


### Designing the future-state healthcare analytics platform


At the core of the solution was the implementation of a Databricks lakehouse architecture on AWS as the client’s healthcare data platform for analytics, governance, and AI. Delta Lake provided the foundation for scalable, reliable data processing, while Databricks Notebooks supported collaborative data engineering and analytics workflows. Standardized ingestion, processing, and governance capabilities improved consistency, strengthened data trust, and enabled analytics and AI at scale.


### Standardizing migration at scale


What started as a limited migration initiative quickly evolved into a broader data platform modernization program. To support that growth, the program established standardized migration and governance frameworks that improved consistency, accelerated delivery, and reduced operational complexity across workloads. Databricks Auto Loader supported scalable ingestion patterns as data and workloads transitioned into the lakehouse.


### Solving for healthcare-scale data complexity


The program modernized large, complex healthcare datasets originating from legacy systems while implementing scalable pipelines capable of supporting petabyte-scale processing. By standardizing data movement, ingestion, and processing with Delta Lake and Databricks, the organization improved access to trusted information and accelerated time to insight.


### Strengthening governance, security, and trust


The modernization effort strengthened governance, security, and compliance through centralized control of data access, permissions, and oversight. Databricks Unity Catalog provided centralized governance and access controls across the lakehouse environment. Beyond reducing administrative complexity, this helped create greater confidence in the consistency and reliability of analytics across the enterprise.


### Removing blockers beyond the code


The program addressed operational barriers including legacy system dependencies, security controls, governance requirements, stakeholder coordination, and enterprise-wide data consolidation efforts. Progress depended as much on stakeholder alignment, governance approvals, security requirements, and cross-functional coordination as it did on technology.


### A modernization program built for scale


Success came from combining modern architecture, strong governance, standardized delivery frameworks, and close collaboration across business and technology stakeholders. The result was a governed, scalable healthcare data platform that reduced operational complexity, improved access to trusted insights, and created the conditions needed to support future analytics and AI initiatives.
